Bengal Minister Seeks Investment from Ambani, Adani

West Bengal Leader of Opposition Suvendu Adhikari met with Mukesh Ambani in Mumbai to discuss potential investments in Bengal. Adhikari also indicated that an Adani hospital is set to break ground in the state.
